Wnt5a is a tumor suppressor in lymphoid malignancies but a tumor promoter in solid cancers.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
Wnt5a is a double-edged sword, which is involved in both tumor suppression and tumor progression.

The main takeaway from our work is that
Wnt5a-Ror2-PCP signaling is a key regulator of cell polarity, cell migration and invasion, and that the role of this pathway in cancer is context-dependent.
